title: SmartDataObject field method naming roles
description: SmartDataObject field method naming roles Each enum constant denotes a configuration key, not the literal generated field or method name.

oneOf.title: Standard getter
oneOf.description: Generated strongly typed accessor that reads a DataObject/SmartDataObject field; required for normal accessor generation.

oneOf.title: Standard setter
oneOf.description: Generated strongly typed mutator that writes a DataObject/SmartDataObject field; required for normal accessor generation.

oneOf.title: Raw getter
oneOf.description: Generated accessor returning the raw field representation before semantic conversion or defaulting; optional, and omitted if unconfigured.

oneOf.title: Raw presence checker
oneOf.description: Generated predicate reporting whether a field is explicitly present in the raw representation, separately from its logical value; optional.

oneOf.title: Raw unsetter
oneOf.description: Generated operation that removes the explicit raw field value or presence marker without assigning a replacement; optional.
